title: Club Founded
description: Liverpool FC was founded on 15 March 1892 by John Houlding after a dispute with Everton FC over the rent at Anfield. The name Liverpool Football Club was officially recognised on 3 June 1892, and the club joined the Football League Second Division the following year.

title: First League Title
description: Liverpool won their first Football League championship, finishing the season top of the First Division under manager Tom Watson.

title: Shankly Arrives
description: Bill Shankly was appointed manager on 1 December 1959. He transformed Liverpool from a Second Division side into one of the greatest clubs in Europe, laying the foundations for decades of glory.

title: First Shankly Title
description: Under Shankly, Liverpool claimed their first league title in 17 years — debuting the iconic all-red strip that autumn — and began an era of dominance in English football.

title: First European Cup
description: Bob Paisley led Liverpool to their maiden European Cup triumph, defeating Borussia Mönchengladbach 3–1 in Rome. Terry McDermott, Tommy Smith and Phil Neal scored on an unforgettable night.

title: Back-to-Back in Europe
description: Bob Paisley's Liverpool retained the European Cup, defeating Club Brugge 1–0 at Wembley. Kenny Dalglish — in his first European final — scored the decisive goal with a deft chip, crowning Liverpool back-to-back champions of Europe.

title: Third European Cup
description: Liverpool claimed their third European Cup in five years, defeating Real Madrid 1–0 in Paris through a late second-half strike from left-back Alan Kennedy. Bob Paisley became the first manager in history to lift the trophy three times.

title: Treble of Major Honours
description: Joe Fagan guided Liverpool to an unprecedented English treble — league title, League Cup and European Cup — in his first season in charge, beating AS Roma on penalties inside their own Stadio Olimpico.

title: Hillsborough Disaster
description: On 15 April 1989, 97 Liverpool supporters unlawfully lost their lives following a crush at Hillsborough during an FA Cup semi-final. Their memory, and the decades-long fight for truth led by their families, bound the city and club together forever.

title: The Cup Treble
description: Gérard Houllier's Liverpool became the first English club to win the FA Cup, League Cup and UEFA Cup in one season. Michael Owen struck twice late on against Arsenal in Cardiff before Liverpool edged Alavés 5–4 via a golden goal in Dortmund, adding the Charity Shield and UEFA Super Cup soon after.

title: Miracle of Istanbul
description: Trailing AC Milan 3–0 at half-time in the Champions League final on 25 May 2005, Rafael Benítez's side scored three times in six extraordinary second-half minutes. Inspired by captain Steven Gerrard and Jerzy Dudek's penalty heroics, Liverpool lifted their fifth European Cup.

title: The 2013/14 Title Charge
description: Driven by Luis Suárez's 31 Premier League goals, Brendan Rodgers' thrilling attacking side led the title race into the final weeks before finishing two points behind Manchester City — one of the most dramatic and agonising campaigns of the modern era.

title: Klopp Era Begins
description: Jürgen Klopp was appointed Liverpool manager on 8 October 2015, promising to turn 'doubters into believers'. Over the next nine years he restored Liverpool to the summit of English, European and world football.

title: Sixth European Cup
description: After an unforgettable 4–0 semi-final comeback against Barcelona at Anfield, Klopp's Liverpool beat Tottenham Hotspur 2–0 in Madrid through Mohamed Salah and Divock Origi to lift a sixth European Cup.

title: World Champions
description: Liverpool won the FIFA Club World Cup for the first time, defeating Flamengo 1–0 in Doha courtesy of Roberto Firmino's extra-time winner.

title: Premier League Champions
description: Liverpool ended a 30-year wait for the English league crown, sealing the 2019/20 Premier League with seven matches to spare — the earliest title triumph in top-flight history — on their way to a club-record 99 points.

title: Chasing the Quadruple
description: Klopp's side played every possible fixture in a 63-game marathon, winning both the League Cup and FA Cup on penalties against Chelsea at Wembley while finishing a single point off the Premier League summit and reaching the Champions League final in Paris.

title: Klopp's Farewell
description: Jürgen Klopp stepped down at the end of the 2023/24 campaign after nine transformative seasons, signing off with a tenth League Cup triumph at Wembley and an emotional Anfield farewell.

title: Slot Takes Charge
description: Dutch head coach Arne Slot arrived from Feyenoord in the summer of 2024 to succeed Klopp, quickly stamping a composed, controlled style onto the squad.

title: 20th League Title
description: Arne Slot guided Liverpool to a record-equalling 20th English league title in his debut season, clinching the 2024/25 Premier League with four games to spare as captain Virgil van Dijk lifted the trophy in front of a jubilant Anfield.

title: Iraola Takes Charge
description: Andoni Iraola was appointed Liverpool head coach in the summer of 2026 after three impressive seasons at AFC Bournemouth, culminating in the club's first-ever European qualification. An Athletic Club icon as a player, the Basque coach brought high-intensity, front-foot football to Anfield.
